response.rationale: A and B are different concepts. A is the Hive, the beehive itself. In ScaleRepository it shows up only as the key used to look up scales: `findByHive(hiveId: string): ScaleRecord[]`. B is the Hive Scale, a weighing device that is linked to a hive and stored as a ScaleRecord. It has its own serial number and weight readings, which is why ScaleService calls ScaleRepository.findBySerial and WeightReadingRepository.findBySerialBetween. The two are also stored separately: ScaleService uses HiveRepository for hives and ScaleRepository for scales. One hive can have scales attached, so the relationship is a link between two things, not one thing under two names.
